image_description: A close-up photograph of a coral fungus (Ramaria species) growing on decaying wood. The fungus features a complex, multi-branched structure with thick, fleshy stalks rising from a common base and dividing into numerous finer, finger-like tips. The coloration is primarily pale cream to light orange-pink, with some darker staining or bruising visible on the lower stems. The background consists of dark, textured bark and patches of green moss.
